name: Summon Fey Ally (General)
body:
You have the power to summon allies from the fey realms to aid you.

Prerequisite(s): Summon nature’s ally spell or ability, non-lawful alignment.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon nature’s ally. Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by fey allies are dispelled when summon nature’s ally ends.

Summon nature’s ally I: grimple (gremlin), fuath (gremlin), jinkin (gremlin), grig (no fiddle), haniver (gremlin), sprite, primordial weasel
Summon nature’s ally II: atomie, brownie, corby (dire), faun (no pipes), grindylow, gathlain, zoog
Summon nature’s ally III: forlarren, jack-o’-lantern, nixie, nuglub (gremlin), pooka, seps (juveline), slurk
Summon nature’s ally IV: adaro, amphisbaena, fey giant toad, living topiary, quickling, peryton, twigjack
Summon nature’s ally V: bagiennik, blodeuwedd, lampad, leucrotta, manticore, pixie, redcap, swan maiden
Summon nature’s ally VI: encantado, hangman tree, oceanid, remorhaz, sangoi, veela (air, earth, fire, water)
Summon nature’s ally VII: adlet, aurumvorax, giant flytrap, ijiraq, nuckelavee, nymph, rukh, sargassum fiend
Summon nature’s ally VIII: catoblepas, frost worm, lukwata, seps, sleipnir
Summon nature’s ally IX: akhlut, ankou, seaweed siren, viper vine
